links.outcome: Under-triage (missed escalation) and over-triage (unnecessary escalation) in synthetic pre-triage cases
links.effect: 28-case test: no under-triage, but 18 cases (64.3%) over-triaged; exact agreement 35.7%, weighted kappa 0.717, MAE 0.75 levels. 11-case ESI evaluation kept zero under-triage.
links.quote: In the 28-case internal diagnostic test, exact agreement was 35.7\%, quadratic-weighted Cohen's $\kappa$ was 0.717, mean absolute error was 0.75 priority levels, and no under-triage occurred.
